input:
A, B, C are three events, one of which must and only one can happen. The odds in favor of A are 4:6, the odds against B are 7:3. Thus, odds against C are

Options:
A. 7 : 3
B. 4 : 6
C. 6 : 4
D. 3 : 7

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Given odds information for A and B in an exhaustive mutually exclusive setup, find odds against C.

given_information.condition: Exactly one of A, B, C occurs

phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Convert odds to probabilities first, then use P(A)+P(B)+P(C)=1.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Find P(A), P(B), compute P(C), then convert to odds against C.
logical_steps: Step 1: Convert odds in favor of A to P(A)
Step 2: Convert odds against B to P(B)
Step 3: Use total probability to get P(C)

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Probabilities sum to 1 and convert back to odds against C as 7:3.
